tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: How this cloud copy of thatsaid is set up: retention, time zone, limits and the file format of transcripts.

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.description: List conversations, newest first. Filter by day (YYYY-MM-DD), date range, a title/speaker/summary query, or status. Archived meetings are hidden unless include_archived is true.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Full-text search across every transcript (all words must appear). Returns matching transcripts with matching lines.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The full Markdown of one conversation (front matter, summary, action items and timestamped transcript). Very long transcripts come in pages: pass nextCursor back as cursor.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Just the metadata, summary and action items of one conversation (much shorter than the transcript).

tools.name: list_fragments
tools.description: Retired: thatsaid deletes empty and junk recordings instead of keeping fragments. Always empty; kept for older clients.

tools.name: list_speakers
tools.description: Names of the people who appear in your conversations (named speakers only; generic labels like "Speaker 2" are left out).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Your account basics: time zone, retention, how many conversations are stored, and when this token expires. No secrets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Your account basics: time zone, retention, how many conversations are stored, and when this token expires. No secrets.
